name: Integrate repository tooling and contributor fix
description: Configure repository-local Dex storage with automatic GitHub issue synchronization, document the workflow for agents, remove obsolete third-party review integration, and directly review and merge PR #21 after validating the marketplace schema. Done when: local Dex configuration is tracked; mutations sync through authenticated gh fallback; obsolete review integration is absent; PR #21 is merged; marketplace metadata is valid for the 0.19 release.

name: Migrate Bevy skills to 0.19 and add accessibility coverage
description: Upgrade the complete Bevy skill suite and supporting scripts from Bevy 0.18 to Bevy 0.19, add a dedicated bevy-a11y skill grounded in authoritative game-accessibility standards and adaptive-controller support, integrate Dex project tracking, and validate all guidance and examples. Done when: every active Bevy skill targets 0.19; stale APIs and incompatible crate recommendations are removed; bevy-a11y includes practical references and tested audit scripts; skill linting, Python checks, link checks, and representative Cargo checks pass; PR #21 is reviewed and integrated; project Dex changes auto-sync to GitHub Issues.

name: Add dedicated bevy-a11y skill
description: Create a focused Bevy 0.19 accessibility skill covering game-specific requirements, WCAG principles where transferable, screen-reader semantics and focus, captions and multimodal feedback, cognitive and motor accessibility, remapping, and accessible/adaptive controller integration. Bundle implementation-oriented audit scripts and authoritative references. Done when: the skill routes concrete accessibility triggers, documents limitations and disabled-player testing, and every script has passing positive and negative tests.

name: Add dedicated Bevy physics skill
description: Create a dedicated bevy-physics skill for Bevy 0.19 projects using bevy_rapier3d/bevy_rapier2d, with a clear boundary from rendering and engine-selection guidance. Cover plugin/features, rigid bodies and colliders, fixed-step scheduling and transform authority, collision events and scene queries, collision groups, sensors, joints, character controllers, interpolation, determinism caveats, debug/headless profiles, and testing. Cross-link the Bevy router, rendering, core scheduling, cameras, and voxel skills. Add a deterministic Cargo-feature audit script only if it prevents recurring headless/debug-feature mistakes. Done when current Rapier compatibility is verified from primary sources, canonical examples compile against Bevy 0.19.1, repository lint/plugin/link checks pass, and Dex sync updates GitHub issue #22.

name: Migrate existing Bevy skills to 0.19
description: Update every active Bevy skill and reference to Bevy 0.19 APIs and current compatible ecosystem crates, preserving historical migration guides where appropriate. Correct resource/component bounds, world serialization names, text and focus APIs, lifecycle hooks, load builders, capture/VFX versions, Cargo feature guidance, WASM stacks, and supporting scripts. Done when: active frontmatter and examples target Bevy 0.19, no stale current-api guidance remains, and representative examples compile against 0.19.1.

name: Add Bevy 0.19 rendering decision skill
description: Create a bevy-rendering skill that explains Bevy 0.19's built-in wgpu renderer, forward versus deferred PBR, 2D/UI composition, custom Material and render-system extension points, render-to-texture/headless operation, and when an external or custom renderer is justified. Correct the category boundary that bevy_rapier3d is a physics engine rather than a rendering alternative, and route physics questions separately. Done when: the router includes the skill; recommendations use verified 0.19 APIs and current ecosystem compatibility; the canonical example compiles; at least two sibling skills are cross-linked.

name: Validate and release the migrated suite
description: Run strict skill linting, generic skill validation, Markdown link checks, Python compilation/help smoke tests, stale-version/API searches, and representative Cargo checks against Bevy 0.19.1. Reconcile the merged PR base, review the final diff for accidental changes, and record evidence in the Dex epic. Done when all relevant checks pass or any explicit compatibility caveats are documented.
